mapper.select: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `${tableName}` ( `id` BIGINT(20) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `date` DATE DEFAULT NULL, `chart_account_id` INT(11) DEFAULT NULL, `company_id` INT(11) DEFAULT NULL, `location_id` INT(11) DEFAULT NULL, `debit` DOUBLE DEFAULT NULL, `credit` DOUBLE DEFAULT NULL, `customer_id` BIGINT(20) DEFAULT NULL, `vendor_id` BIGINT(20) DEFAULT NULL, `employee_id` BIGINT(20) DEFAULT NULL, `other_id` BIGINT(20) DEFAULT NULL, `class_id` BIGINT(20) DEFAULT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`id`), KEY `chart_account_id` (`chart_account_id`), KEY `company_id` (`company_id`), KEY `location_id` (`location_id`), KEY `date` (`date`) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8 COLLATE=utf8_unicode_ci;

SELECT SUM(debit) AS debit, SUM(credit) AS credit, `date` AS date, chart_account_id AS chartAccountId, company_id AS companyId, location_id AS locationId, customer_id AS customerId, vendor_id AS vendorId, employee_id AS employeeId, other_id AS otherId, class_id AS classId FROM general_ledgers gl INNER JOIN general_ledger_details gld ON gl.id = gld.general_ledger_id WHERE gl.is_approve=1 AND gl.is_active=1
AND DATE(gl.date) <= DATE(#{filter.dateTo})
GROUP BY `date`, chart_account_id, company_id, location_id, customer_id, vendor_id, employee_id, other_id, class_id
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS `${tableName}`;

SELECT g.id AS accountGroupId, g.name AS accountGroupName,
FROM chart_account_groups g INNER JOIN chart_account_types t ON g.chart_account_type_id=t.id WHERE g.is_active=1 AND t.name IN ('Income') ORDER BY t.id

SELECT id AS charAccountId, CONCAT_WS(' ',account_codes,'·',account_description) AS chartAccountName,
FROM chart_accounts coa WHERE is_active = 1 AND chart_account_group_id= #{groupId} HAVING totalAmount != 0 ORDER BY account_codes
SELECT #{date} AS date, IFNULL(SUM(debit) - SUM(credit), 0) AS totalAmount FROM general_ledgers gl INNER JOIN general_ledger_details gld ON gl.id = gld.general_ledger_id
SELECT #{date} AS date, IFNULL(SUM(credit) - SUM(debit), 0) AS totalAmount FROM general_ledgers gl INNER JOIN general_ledger_details gld ON gl.id = gld.general_ledger_id

SELECT id AS charAccountId, CONCAT_WS(' ',account_codes,'·',account_description) AS chartAccountName,
FROM chart_accounts coa WHERE is_active = 1 AND chart_account_group_id= #{groupId} HAVING totalAmount != 0 ORDER BY account_codes

SELECT id AS charAccountId, (SELECT id FROM chart_accounts WHERE id = coa.parent_id) AS parentId, (SELECT CONCAT_WS(' ', account_codes, '·', account_description) FROM chart_accounts WHERE id = coa.parent_id) AS parentName, CONCAT_WS(' ', account_codes, '·', account_description) AS chartAccountName,
FROM chart_accounts coa WHERE is_active = 1 AND chart_account_group_id = #{groupId} HAVING totalAmount != 0 ORDER BY parentName, account_codes;
